name: Archimedes
description: Agentic trading, grounded in research — settled on Arc. Turns a natural-language investment intent into a research-grounded, rigor-gated portfolio strategy, executed in a non-custodial USDC vault on the Arc testnet (chain ID 5042002).

authentication.description: Use /api/auth/* and retain session cookie. Optional EIP-4361 wallet proof uses /api/wallets/* and never creates a session.

skills.name: Generate strategy
skills.description: Turn a natural-language investment intent into a rigor-gated portfolio strategy (DSR / PBO / walk-forward OOS), grounded in the quantitative-finance research corpus.

skills.name: Deploy vault
skills.description: Execute a generated, rigor-passing strategy into a non-custodial USDC vault on Arc.

skills.name: Monitor
skills.description: Read a deployed vault's live health, allocations, and performance.

skills.name: Publish
skills.description: Publish a strategy to the nanopayment marketplace for other agents or users to subscribe to.

skills.name: Subscribe
skills.description: Subscribe to a published strategy via sub-cent USDC nanopayments (x402 / Circle Gateway).
